# Corbelle

> Corbelle is a London-based business optimisation practice founded by Brendan Ellis (ACCA Fellow, former Head of Data). It helps UK owner-led businesses with 50 to 400 staff find the hours lost to manual work, connect the systems they already have, and adopt AI safely. Work is fixed price and people first, and starts with a free time audit.

Key facts:
- Who it is for: owners and managing directors of UK owner-led businesses with 50 to 400 staff.
- Average time saved: 7 hours per person, per week.
- First step: a free 30-minute time audit call, https://cal.com/brennie/30min
- Contact: hello@corbelle.ai
- Company: Corbelle Limited, registered in England and Wales, company number 08106968.
- Specialist partners (cyber security, data engineering, branding, software builds) are brought in under one plan. Where a partner or vendor pays Corbelle a revenue share, Corbelle says so up front.

## Services
- [What we do: process, automation and AI](https://www.corbelle.ai/services.html): What Corbelle does: time and process audits, automation and AI, joined-up systems, change management, strategy and fractional leadership, and AI adoption.
- [Time & Process Audit for UK businesses](https://www.corbelle.ai/time-process-audit.html): Find out where your team's hours go and what each manual step costs, before you spend a penny on software. A fixed-price time and process audit.
- [Business Automation & AI Quick Wins](https://www.corbelle.ai/automation-ai.html): Kill the copy-paste. Corbelle automates repetitive jobs using tools you already pay for, and uses AI only where it genuinely saves time.
- [Joined-Up Systems: connect the tools you have](https://www.corbelle.ai/joined-up-systems.html): Stop re-keying the same data into three places. Corbelle connects the systems you already have so information lives once.
- [Change Management for growing businesses](https://www.corbelle.ai/change-management.html): New ways of working only stick if people own them. Change management that brings your team with you and is still working six months on.
- [Strategy & Fractional Leadership](https://www.corbelle.ai/strategy-leadership.html): Senior direction without the full-time hire: independent assessments, roadmaps, partner selection and a fractional technology and operations lead.
- [Practical AI Adoption for owner-led businesses](https://www.corbelle.ai/ai-adoption.html): Practical AI for owner-led businesses. Fix the process first, then use AI where it saves time, with simple rules your team understands.

## About
- [Our story: about Corbelle and Brendan Ellis](https://www.corbelle.ai/about.html): Corbelle is a London-based business optimisation practice founded by Brendan Ellis, ACCA Fellow and former Head of Data.
- [Experience and track record](https://www.corbelle.ai/experience.html): Twenty years inside Big 4, banking, private equity and media, and Corbelle clients from multi-country groups to trade businesses.
- [Case studies: process and AI results](https://www.corbelle.ai/case-studies.html): Real Corbelle client work: what was broken, what we changed, and what it's worth now.
- [Specialist partners](https://www.corbelle.ai/partners.html): Corbelle stays deliberately small and brings in trusted specialists for cyber security, data engineering, branding and software builds, under one plan.

## Insights
- [5 manual jobs every growing business still does](https://www.corbelle.ai/five-manual-jobs.html): Five manual jobs quietly eating hours in growing UK businesses, and the cheapest way to stop each one, usually with tools you already own.
- [You need a Tuesday strategy, not an AI strategy](https://www.corbelle.ai/tuesday-strategy.html): Most owner-led businesses don't need an AI strategy deck. They need to know what AI should do on a normal Tuesday. Here's how to find it.
- [Busy isn't a badge. It's a symptom.](https://www.corbelle.ai/busy-is-a-symptom.html): When everyone is busy, it's tempting to hire. But busy is usually a symptom of broken processes, not a shortage of people.
- [Before you approve a ChatGPT-padded tech quote](https://www.corbelle.ai/chatgpt-padded-quote.html): Suppliers and buyers are using AI to write and review tech proposals, and scope is creeping up. Five checks before you sign.
- [Who sees the AI bill?](https://www.corbelle.ai/who-sees-the-ai-bill.html): AI tools are cheap to try and easy to forget. Once they sit inside core processes, usage costs grow quietly. Who owns the bill in your business?

## Tools
- [Tools for process, AI and cost decisions](https://www.corbelle.ai/tools.html): Free and paid Corbelle tools: the cost of busywork calculator, AI Use Case Gameplan, AI Cost Validator and more.
- [AI Implementation Cost Validator](https://www.corbelle.ai/aicost): Model the operating cost of an AI implementation before usage, seats, review and overhead turn it into an uncontrolled expense.
- [The Process Pain Check](https://www.corbelle.ai/check): Find the costly process holding your organisation back, estimate what it consumes and discover the next decision that will move it forward.
- [Clarity Engine: structured decision memos](https://www.corbelle.ai/clarity-engine): A Corbelle skill that turns high-stakes choices into structured decision memos, explicit trade-offs and scheduled retrospectives.
- [Cost of Inaction Diagnostic](https://www.corbelle.ai/costofinaction): Put a board-level financial frame around deferring a technology investment, before operating drag, risk and lost growth force the decision.
- [Magnetic Leadership tool](https://www.corbelle.ai/magneticleadership): A Corbelle tool for leaders who want to build trust, presence and influence with their team and board.
- [AI Use Case Gameplan](https://www.corbelle.ai/usecasegameplan): Pressure-test one AI use case and get a clear, phased plan for what to fix first.
